source_of_truth: Overrides service variant count fields where brochure/source service counts differ from older 40-piece recipe batch yields. Kitchen prep uses kitchen_production_count.

platter.source_note: Brochure/source count is 12 pieces per scone platter. Older 40-piece recipe yield is batch logic, not platter service count.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Edible flowers, strawberry halves or citrus zest as optional premium finish.
platter.service_rule: Cream and jam separate for delivery unless platter is for immediate service.

platter.source_note: Brochure/source count is 12 pieces per sweet slice/cake platter. Older 40-piece recipe yield is batch logic, not platter service count.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Edible flowers, dried citrus, berries or gold-dusted crumb where appropriate.
platter.service_rule: Keep chilled where required; separate wet garnishes until service.

platter.source_note: Brochure/source count is 12 croissants per platter. Older 40-piece recipe yield is batch logic, not platter service count.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
platter.service_rule: Best served fresh or lightly warmed only when service timing allows. Do not seal hot croissants for long delivery.

grazing_add_on_40.portion: 40 croissants only when the package item is explicitly named as a 40-piece grazing add-on
grazing_add_on_40.source_note: Named brochure grazing add-on exception. The normal croissant platter remains 12.

platter.portion: 24 sandwich points per platter from 6 whole sandwiches
platter.source_note: Brochure/source count is 24 sandwich points from 6 whole sandwiches. Kitchen-facing prep sheets must still define exact filling split.
platter.standard_garnish: neat cut faces, paper lining and restrained herbs
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, edible flowers or premium fruit garnish when event style supports it.
platter.service_rule: Keep fillings defined by event prep sheet. Do not use chef's selection for kitchen-facing counts.

platter.source_note: Brochure/source count is 12 wrap pieces per platter. Older 40-piece recipe yield is batch logic, not platter service count.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
platter.service_rule: Cut cleanly, pack tight, and keep chilled. Avoid wet fillings against wrap edges for long holding.

platter.source_note: Brochure/source count is 12 mini brioche rolls per platter. Older 40-piece recipe yield is batch logic, not platter service count.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, edible flowers or premium fruit garnish as optional finish.
platter.service_rule: Assemble close to delivery. Keep wet sauces controlled to protect brioche.

platter.portion: 24 sandwich points per platter from 6 whole sandwiches
platter.source_note: Treat as sandwich platter logic unless a newer source splits this as a separate 12-piece roll/brioche item.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, beetroot powder or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
platter.service_rule: Keep roast beef chilled and protected. Add wet relish cleanly so bread/wrap does not bleed before service.

platter.portion: 48 mixed hot nibbles per platter, 12 each of 4 items
platter.split: 12 sausage rolls, 12 spinach pizzinis, 12 beef pies, 12 quiche Lorraine
platter.source_note: Brochure/source range is 40-50 pieces. Locked kitchen production count is 48 pieces for efficient 12-each production.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Flat parsley, micro herbs or edible flowers only if presentation needs lifting.
platter.service_rule: Reheat close to delivery/service and avoid covered long holding that softens pastry.

platter.portion: 48 mixed hot nibbles per box/platter, 12 each of 4 items
platter.source_note: Wake/funeral mixed hot nibble source range is 40-50 pieces. Locked kitchen production count is 48 pieces.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Flat parsley, micro herbs or edible flowers only if presentation needs lifting.
platter.service_rule: Pack hot nibbles by type where possible. Vent briefly before closing to protect pastry texture.
